label: champ_0150_rival_01
text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! [VAR 0x0101(0001)]!\c\nYou did it! Aaah, I’m so happy for you! This is\nthe best![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0150_rival_02
text: I know I said I wasn’t worried, but my heart was\nstill pounding the whole time![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0150_rival_07
text: Seriously. Pat yourself on the back—you beat\nevery single Gym![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_03
text: Now that you’ve gathered eight Gym Badges...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_04
text: all that’s left is to take on the Pokémon League![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_05
text: If you hope to stand alongside Nemona as a\nfellow Champion...[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_06
text: head to the Pokémon League. That is where you\ncan take on the Champion Assessment.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_rival_04
text: Yeah—hurry up and get to my rank! I’m itching\nfor a battle of equals![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0150_rival_05
text: I’ve gotta take the time while you’re facing the\nPokémon League to fine-tune my Pokémon’s\r\nmoves and revamp all my tactics![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_07
text: It’s unusual for me to see her so excited—\nthough perhaps not for you.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_08
text: She must really be happy that she finally has a\nfriend who can keep pace with her own talents.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_09
text: There’s a special kind of strength that can only\nbe reached by competing with a good rival.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_10
text: Count me among those eager to see how far\nyou two can go![VAR 0x0114(0011)]

label: champ_0150_chairman_11
text: In any case, I’ll be waiting for you at the\nPokémon League, northwest of Mesagoza.[VAR 0x0114(0011)]
